query:
UPDATE users
            SET
                email        = $1,
                display_name = $2,
                avatar_url   = $3,
                password_hash = $4,
                token_secret  = $5,
                totp_secret   = $6,
                totp_enabled  = $7,
                status        = $8,
                updated_at    = now()
            WHERE id = $9
            RETURNING
                id,
                email,
                display_name,
                avatar_url,
                password_hash,
                token_secret,
                totp_secret,
                totp_enabled,
                status,
                created_at,
                updated_at
